def transform(grid):
    # A full-width uniform separator divides the mask from the image.
    split = next(i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] != 0)
    mask = grid[:split]
    image = grid[split + 1:]
    return [[2 if image[r][c] != 0 and mask[r][c] != 0 else 0
             for c in range(len(mask[0]))] for r in range(len(mask))]

source = '''def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])

    for i, row in enumerate(grid):
        if row and row[0] != 0 and all(value == row[0] for value in row):
            before, after = grid[:i], grid[i + 1:]
            if before and len(before) == len(after) and all(len(r) == width for r in before + after):
                return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(ra, rb)]
                        for ra, rb in zip(before, after)]

    for j in range(width):
        color = grid[0][j]
        if color != 0 and all(row[j] == color for row in grid):
            before = [row[:j] for row in grid]
            after = [row[j + 1:] for row in grid]
            if j > 0 and j == width - j - 1:
                return [[2 if a != 0 and b != 0 else 0 for a, b in zip(ra, rb)]
                        for ra, rb in zip(before, after)]

    raise ValueError("No centered full separator divides the grid into equal panels")
'''
